issued_documents_subject_uq.name: issued_documents_subject_uq
issued_documents_subject_uq.where: subject_id IS NOT NULL AND superseded_by IS NULL

stationery_batches_variant_check.name: stationery_batches_variant_check
stationery_batches_variant_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_batches"."variant" is null or "fees"."stationery_batches"."variant" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,20}$') and ("fees"."stationery_batches"."valid_efy" is null or "fees"."stationery_batches"."valid_efy" between 2000 and 2100) and ("fees"."stationery_batches"."unit_cost_santim" is null or "fees"."stationery_batches"."unit_cost_santim" >= 0)

stationery_items_key_check.name: stationery_items_key_check
stationery_items_key_check.value: "fees"."stationery_items"."series" ~ '^[A-Z\u1200-\u135A]{0,6}$' and "fees"."stationery_items"."serial" between 1 and 99999999 and "fees"."stationery_items"."width" between 1 and 8 and "fees"."stationery_items"."item_key" = "fees"."stationery_items"."series" || lpad("fees"."stationery_items"."serial"::text, "fees"."stationery_items"."width", '0')

stationery_items_used_check.name: stationery_items_used_check
stationery_items_used_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_items"."status" = 'used') = ("fees"."stationery_items"."used_for_id" is not null and "fees"."stationery_items"."used_for_table" is not null)

stationery_items_end_check.name: stationery_items_end_check
stationery_items_end_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_items"."end_reason" is null) = ("fees"."stationery_items"."status" not in ('spoiled', 'void', 'missing')) and ("fees"."stationery_items"."end_reason" is null or "fees"."stationery_items"."end_reason" in ('misprinted', 'damaged', 'lost', 'stolen', 'not_found_at_count', 'other'))

stationery_movements_units_check.name: stationery_movements_units_check
stationery_movements_units_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_movements"."movement" in ('allocate', 'recall')) = ("fees"."stationery_movements"."from_unit_id" is not null and "fees"."stationery_movements"."to_unit_id" is not null)

cases_due_idx.name: cases_due_idx
cases_due_idx.where: due_at is not null and closed_at is null

bolos_status_check.name: bolos_status_check
bolos_status_check.value: (status <> 'valid' OR sticker_key IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'temporary' OR temporary_until IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'void' OR void_reason IS NOT NULL)

driver_licences_case_uq.name: driver_licences_case_uq
driver_licences_case_uq.where: case_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'voided'

driver_licences_active_check.name: driver_licences_active_check
driver_licences_active_check.value: status <> 'active' OR (number IS NOT NULL AND issued_on IS NOT NULL AND valid_until IS NOT NULL)

exam_results_scores_check.name: exam_results_scores_check
exam_results_scores_check.value: coalesce(theory, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND coalesce(practical, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 100

plate_assignments_replaced_check.name: plate_assignments_replaced_check
plate_assignments_replaced_check.value: "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."replaced_by_id" is null or ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."until" is not null and "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."replaced_by_id" <> "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."id")

plate_assignments_legacy_check.name: plate_assignments_legacy_check
plate_assignments_legacy_check.value: ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."format" = 'legacy') = ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."legacy_use_code" is not null) and ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."legacy_use_code" is null or "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."legacy_use_code" in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 35))

plate_movements_units_check.name: plate_movements_units_check
plate_movements_units_check.value: ("vehicles"."plate_movements"."kind" in ('allocate', 'recall')) = ("vehicles"."plate_movements"."from_unit_id" is not null and "vehicles"."plate_movements"."to_unit_id" is not null)

plates_vehicle_check.name: plates_vehicle_check
plates_vehicle_check.value: ("vehicles"."plates"."status" in ('assigned', 'retired') and "vehicles"."plates"."vehicle_id" is not null) or ("vehicles"."plates"."status" in ('in_stock', 'allocated', 'reserved', 'void') and "vehicles"."plates"."vehicle_id" is null) or "vehicles"."plates"."status" = 'lost'

plates_end_check.name: plates_end_check
plates_end_check.value: ("vehicles"."plates"."end_reason" is null) = ("vehicles"."plates"."status" not in ('retired', 'void', 'lost')) and ("vehicles"."plates"."end_reason" is null or "vehicles"."plates"."end_reason" in ('exchanged', 'retired', 'transferred', 'lost', 'stolen', 'damaged', 'misprinted', 'other'))

vehicle_owners_one_holder_check.name: vehicle_owners_one_holder_check
vehicle_owners_one_holder_check.value: ("vehicles"."vehicle_owners"."person_id" is not null)::int + ("vehicles"."vehicle_owners"."organisation_id" is not null)::int = 1

vehicles_figures_check.name: vehicles_figures_check
vehicles_figures_check.value:
coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."seats", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."load_capacity_kg", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."gross_weight_kg", 1) > 0
                        and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."engine_cc", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."axles", 1) > 0

vehicles_details_check.name: vehicles_details_check
vehicles_details_check.value:
coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."engine_hp", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."cylinders", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."length_mm", 1) > 0
                        and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."width_mm", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."height_mm", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."tyres", 1) > 0
                        and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."net_weight_kg", 1) > 0 and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."made_in"), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."tyre_size"), 1) between 1 and 20

vehicles_migration_check.name: vehicles_migration_check
vehicles_migration_check.value:
("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_source" is null) = ("vehicles"."vehicles"."paper_reference" is null)
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."paper_reference"), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_source" is distinct from 'back_capture'
                             or ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_case_id" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_by" is not null
                                 and "vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_at" is not null))
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_by" is null) = ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_at" is null)

vehicles_text_check.name: vehicles_text_check
vehicles_text_check.value:
length("vehicles"."vehicles"."make") between 1 and 60 and length("vehicles"."vehicles"."model") between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."engine_number"), 1) between 1 and 30 and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."colour"), 1) between 1 and 30
